newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Comalco signs power pact for Bell Bay.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Comalco signs power pact for Bell Bay.

text.p: Australian aluminium producer Comalco Ltd said on Friday it had signed a new power supply contract that ensured the future of its Bell Bay aluminium smelter until at least 2104.
The contract was signed on Friday by Comalco and Tasmania state's Hydroelectric Corp (HEC), which would supply an average 256 megawatts of power to the smelter, Comalco said.

"The signing now enables Comalco, the HEC and Tasmania to plan ahead with confidence that the Bell Bay smelter is going to be here for the foreseeable future," Comalco chief executive Terry Palmer said in a statement.
"This new power agreement gives us the ability to oeprate the Bell Bay smelter at a higher level of output than ever before."
Bell Bay resumed full production last year and expects to produce 138,000 tonnes of aluminium for domestic and overseas customers in 1997, the statement said.
The existing power contract with the HEC was due to expire in 2001, the company said.
